weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a tender blue, with only a scattering of cloud to soften the edges of the sun. The day ahead looks mostly sunny and clean-lined, the air clear enough to make colors feel newly washed. Even in late winter the midday sun has some bite, so expect the UV to climb to a moderate hum around lunch; the light will be bright, the shadows crisp, and the sky likely to stay dry.

It should feel pleasant rather than bracing: start with light layers, a soft jumper you can shrug off by late morning, sunglasses, and a dab of sunscreen on nose and forearms. It’s a good day for small, ordinary pleasures—walk the errands instead of driving, linger over a coffee by an open window, water the pots on the balcony, or take a quiet loop through a nearby park and let the few clouds drift by like slow boats.
